title: Death Journal
description: A lightweight client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that saves and displays your recent death locations.
body:
## Death Journal

Death Journal is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that helps you keep track of where you died.

The mod saves your recent death locations locally and records useful details such as coordinates, dimension, and timestamp. You can browse saved entries in a simple in-game journal screen, quickly check your latest death through a small HUD panel, and use client-side commands for fast access.

## Features

- Saves your recent death locations locally
- Stores coordinates, dimension, and timestamp
- In-game Death Journal screen for browsing saved entries
- HUD display showing your latest death
- Client-side commands for quick access
- Client-side only: not required on servers

## Commands

- `/deathjournal` — Open the Death Journal screen
- `/deathjournal last` — Show the latest saved death entry
- `/deathjournal clear` — Clear saved entries for the current world or server

## Notes

- Data is stored locally on the client
- Entries are separated per world/server
- The mod is client-side only and does not need to be installed on the server
